description: This removes all installed versions of {{name}} managed by Portcove.
failure: Removal did not complete. Review the current installation and any recovery notice before trying again.
interrupted: If interrupted, Portcove retains a recovery journal and checks removal when the library reopens. Review any recovery notice before another attempt; interrupted deletion may finish.

kept: Portcove keeps the saved data and backups listed here, and your original game files. Saved game-file locations and the original folders used for copied installations are also kept. Other games are unaffected.
preservedAt: Saved data will be preserved at:
settingsRemoved: This game's saved release-channel and update-policy settings will also be removed. Sign-ins stored only inside installed versions are deleted with those versions.
